'''Wah Chiu''' ({{lang-zh|t=趙華}}) is a Hong Kong-born American biophysicist, currently the Wallenberg-Bienenstock Chair Professor in the department of bioengineering, department of microbiology and immunology and the Photon Science Directorate of SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory at [[Stanford University]].  He is a Stanford Bio-X affiliated Faculty.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://profiles.stanford.edu/wah-chiu |title=Wah Chiu |publisher=stanford.edu |access-date=September 1, 2017}}</ref> He was formerly the Distinguished Service Professor and the Alvin Romansky Chair Professor at [[Baylor College of Medicine]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.bcm.edu/people/view/wah-chiu-ph-d/b279d3f6-ffed-11e2-be68-080027880ca6 |title=Wah Chiu |publisher=bcm.edu |access-date=April 22, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.bcm.edu/research/labs/wah-chiu |title=Wah Chiu |publisher=bcm.edu |access-date=April 22, 2017}}</ref>  where he was the founding director of the National Center for Biomolecular Imaging,<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://ncmi.bcm.edu/ncmi/ |title=National Center for Biomolecular Imaging}}</ref> and has been active in the new cryo-EM techniques allowing much higher-resolution structures of large molecular complexes such as viruses <ref>{{cite journal |author=ML Baker |author2=CF Hryc |author3=Q Zhang |author4=W Wu |author5=J Jakana |author6=C Haas-Pettingell |author7=PA ==Biography==
Chiu was born in Hong Kong, and attended [[Pui Ching Middle School (Hong Kong)|Pui Ching Middle School]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sibs.cas.cn/xwdt/hzjl/201412/t20141230_4283942.html|title=贝勒医学院赵华教授来生化与细胞所作学术报告|publisher=Shanghai Institutes for Biological Sciences|date=2012-09-12|access-date=2018-05-03}}</ref> He moved to the U.S. to study at [[University of California, Berkeley]], where he received both his B.S. (1969) and Ph.D. (1975). He was elected an academician of Taiwan's [[Academia Sinica]] in 2008 and a member of the [[United States National Academy of Sciences]] in 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://db1n.sinica.edu.tw/textdb/ioconas/binfo1N.php?_session=0&_op=?ID:L093|title=趙華|publisher=Academia Sinica|access-date=2018-05-03}}</ref> He has also received several honors including the Distinguished Science Award from the Microscopy Society of America<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.microscopy.org/awards/2014_awardsrecipient.cfm|title=Awards & Scholarships|website=Microscopy Society of America|access-date=2018-10-07}}</ref> and the Honorary Doctorate of Philosophy from the University of Helsinki, Finland  in 2014.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.helsinki.fi/fil-promootio2014/lehdistotiedote1-en.shtml|title=Helsingin yliopisto - filosofisen tiedekunnan promootio 2014|website=www.helsinki.fi|access-date=2018-10-07}}</ref>
